challenges.code:
DOCS = {
    "doc-pricing": [2, 0, 3],
    "doc-quota": [1, 3, 1],
    "doc-auth": [0, 1, 4],
}
QUERY = [2, 0, 2]

def dot(a, b):
    return sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b))

def retrieve(query, docs, k):
    scored = [(name, dot(query, vec)) for name, vec in docs.items()]
    scored.sort(key=lambda p: (-p[1], p[0]))
    return scored[:k]

results = retrieve(QUERY, DOCS, 2)
for rank, (name, score) in enumerate(results, start=1):
    print(f"{rank}. {name} (score={score})")
print("grounded answer uses 2 chunks")

assert dot([2, 0, 2], [2, 0, 3]) == 10
assert dot([2, 0, 2], [0, 1, 4]) == 8
assert dot([2, 0, 2], [1, 3, 1]) == 4
_r = retrieve(QUERY, DOCS, 2)
assert _r == [("doc-pricing", 10), ("doc-auth", 8)]
assert retrieve(QUERY, DOCS, 3) == [("doc-pricing", 10), ("doc-auth", 8), ("doc-quota", 4)]
assert retrieve([1, 1, 1], {"a": [1, 0, 0], "b": [0, 1, 0]}, 2) == [("a", 1), ("b", 1)]
